item.text:
**4B.9 Verdict**  
**No.** The 2024 record shows extensive use of internet shutdowns, platform blocking, surveillance-related opacity, and administrative pressure on media and critics. The only real counterevidence I found was judicial pushback, not a Sharif-led rollback.

**Evidence**
- **Pakistan: Authorities must be transparent about internet disruptions and surveillance tech** | Amnesty International | 2024-08-26 | [URL](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/08/pakistan-authorities-must-be-transparent-about-internet-disruptions-and-surveillance-tech/)  
  Claim: Amnesty says Pakistani authorities were opaque about monitoring and surveillance technologies that block content, slow internet speeds, and use national firewalls. That is direct evidence of digital control that undermines political freedom.  
  IDs: `4B.9`, `4B.6`, `4B.4`

- **Social media platform X blocked in Pakistan over national security, ministry says** | Reuters / Investing.com | 2024-04-17 | [URL](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/social-media-platform-x-blocked-in-pakistan-over-national-security-ministry-says-3382313)  
  Claim: Pakistan’s interior ministry said it blocked X around the election period on national-security grounds, confirming a long-suspected platform restriction that continued into Sharif’s term.  
  IDs: `4B.9`, `4B.6`, `4B.5`

- **Pakistan: Election-day internet shutdown is a reckless attack on people’s rights** | Amnesty International | 2024-02-08 | [URL](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/pakistan-election-day-internet-shutdown-is-a-reckless-attack-on-peoples-rights/)  
  Claim: Amnesty condemned the election-day telecom/mobile internet shutdown as a blunt attack on expression and assembly. This was under the caretaker setup rather than Sharif’s cabinet, but it set the coercive information environment around his ascent.  
  IDs: `4B.9`, `4B.6`, `4B.8`

- **Pakistan: Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report** | Freedom House | 2024 | [URL](https://freedomhouse.org/country/pakistan/freedom-net/2024)  
  Claim: Freedom House says authorities throttled internet during a January 2024 PTI virtual rally, left X/Facebook/Instagram/YouTube inaccessible, imposed an election-day mobile internet suspension, and planned upgrades to PTA surveillance/blocking systems. This is strong evidence of state digital control.  
  IDs: `4B.9`, `4B.6`, `4B.3`, `4B.5`

- **2024 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices: Pakistan** | U.S. Department of State | 2024 | [URL](https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128431.html)  
  Claim: The report says PEMRA, PTA, network access, government advertising, and FIA notices were used to pressure media, suppress threatening information, and warn journalists/YouTubers. That is direct evidence of administrative harassment and information control.  
  IDs: `4B.9`, `4B.6`, `4B.5`, `4B.7`

- **A dangerous digital crackdown** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-12-12 | [URL](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/12/dangerous-digital-crackdown)  
  Claim: HRW says the government was expanding internet throttling, VPN restrictions, and PECA-based controls, while proposing new bodies to prosecute online content and keep X blocked. This shows the digital crackdown deepened by late 2024.  
  IDs: `4B.9`, `4B.6`, `4B.5`

- **High courts moved against Pemra gag order on TV reporting of court proceedings** | Dawn | 2024-05-23 | [URL](https://www.dawn.com/news/1835228/high-courts-moved-against-pemra-gag-order-on-tv-reporting-of-court-proceedings)  
  Claim: Civil society and journalists won temporary judicial pushback against a PEMRA gag order on court reporting. This is the best counterevidence, but it reflects court restraint, not a Sharif-led defense of media freedom.  
  IDs: `4B.9`, `4B.6`, `4B.4`

**Gap**
- I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Sharif personally rolled back the X ban, reduced PTA/PEMRA controls, or issued a clear pro-freedom directive against surveillance or shutdowns.
- The strongest “positive” material is indirect: court rulings that restrained censorship, not executive protection of political freedom.
- Several major restrictions began under the caretaker setup before Sharif took office, but they persisted into his government and were not reversed.
